names.ja: シッサス・ロンビフォリア

light.best.quote: It needs average to cool indoor temperatures and bright, indirect light.

light.min.quote: Grape Ivy is tolerant of low relative humidity, heavy shade, and prefers moist soil.

temperature.minC.quote: Do not allow indoor temperatures below 50 degrees F.

temperature.idealC.quote: It needs average to cool indoor temperatures

temperature.idealC.reason: 「ふつう〜涼しめの室温」をやや低めの範囲に当てはめた

humidity.quote: Grape Ivy is tolerant of low relative humidity

watering.growing.quote: Apply consistent moisture from spring to fall
Allow this plant to dry out between each watering

tips.ja: 湿りすぎても乾きすぎても葉が落ちる。
tips.quote: The leaves may fall if the plant is too wet or too dry.

tips.ja: 葉の緑が濃ければ、肥料は足りている。
tips.quote: Dark green leaves mean there's an adequate fertilizer level.

note: 現在の学名は Cissus alata（以前は Cissus rhombifolia）。
